Indian Railways Revamps IRCTC Website for Faster Tatkal Bookings

Indian Railways has launched a revamped IRCTC beta website, introduced on July 15, aimed at speeding up Tatkal ticket bookings. The changes include a token system, altered timing, and measures to reduce crowding. Online railway ticket bookings have reached a record 89.84% share. Some reports also mention potential festive price hikes.
